name: Redis
description: Official Redis plugin for Claude Code that helps AI coding agents build and optimize applications with Redis. It provides Redis development best practices across data modeling, key design, caching, query engine usage, vector search, semantic caching, connection handling, performance, security, and observability, so agents can generate better code and make safer architectural choices when working with Redis.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install redis@claude-community` from `redis/agent-skills` (`plugins/redis-development`).

Official Redis plugin for Claude Code that helps AI coding agents build and optimize applications with Redis. It provides Redis development best practices across data modeling, key design, caching, query engine usage, vector search, semantic caching, connection handling, performance, security, and observability, so agents can generate better code and make safer architectural choices when working with Redis.
